title: Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston

thread.title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden • Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston: Byoujaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Kamigoroshi no Bujin no Karei naru Musouroku - Episode 6 discussion

opinions.point: Most commenters enjoyed Nia’s exaggerated battle-loving personality and found her reactions entertaining.
The sibling-focused character moments, especially involving Nia and Neal, were repeatedly praised as warm and appealing.
Several commenters found the episode funny, particularly the contrast between Nia’s public image and her aggressive enthusiasm.
Some viewers were underwhelmed by the tournament premise or wanted stronger opponents for Nia, but still found the episode entertaining overall.
Commenters were enthusiastic about the next episode and interested in the darker fighting setting being introduced.
